title: CFB Game Total — Preserve Frozen Backend Step 2
problem: The native website rebuild needs an explicit immutable boundary around the already-certified CFB Game Total backend so later presentation steps cannot silently alter model math, final synthesis, normalized model-input routing, sportsbook influence, market inputs, or Monte Carlo policy.
root_cause: Step 1 correctly changed only Page-1 presentation routing, but the rebuild did not yet have a dedicated rebuild-scoped proof that pins the certified Step 11/12 Game Total backend and the active normalized-input adapters to exact blobs and contract values.
patch: Add a devsystem-only backend preservation guard and regression tests. The guard pins seven existing Game Total backend artifacts to exact Git blob SHAs, validates the permanent CFB V12 Step 11/12 contracts, and verifies the active normalized-input adapter still delegates raw/final math to the frozen V1 owners with zero sportsbook influence. No product runtime module is modified.
forbidden_scope: market price or implied probability inputs

tdd.red_result: The test-first contract imported devsystem.cfb_game_total_backend_preservation_step2_v1 before that module existed, so the contract was structurally RED until the guard implementation was added.
